lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Mg20 (DyMg10) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows Dy centers with 12 geometric neighbors (8 Mg, 4 Y) and Mg centers adopting close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances of 2.992–3.389 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing relations.
